name: NDB-UFES/SAB public source-image index
description: One public-safe row per source-image group. Counts are atlas-level evidence summaries and are not a replacement for thesis relationship metadata.

columns.name: validated_wsi_id
columns.description: Retained compatibility name for the pseudonymous source-image group.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Evidence source role for the source-image group.

columns.name: patch_count
columns.description: Number of atlas patches assigned to the source image.

columns.name: patch_pair_count
columns.description: Number of unordered same-source-image patch pairs, n × (n - 1) / 2.

columns.name: similarity_pair_count
columns.description: Number of same-source-image pair rows present in the validated similarity artifact; this can be lower than the theoretical pair count.

columns.name: patches_with_overlap
columns.description: Number of patches that overlap at least one other patch by recovered coordinates.

columns.name: overlapping_pair_count
columns.description: Number of same-source-image patch pairs with positive coordinate overlap.

columns.name: mapped_image_area_percent
columns.description: Union of clipped patch boxes divided by displayed source-image area, as a percentage.

columns.name: repeated_sampled_area_percent
columns.description: Multiply-covered coordinate area divided by mapped patch union area, as a percentage.

columns.name: repeated_full_wsi_image_area_percent
columns.description: Retained field name for multiply-covered coordinate area divided by displayed source-image area, as a percentage.

columns.name: ndb_wsi_label
columns.description: Retained field name for the source-level label carried by public NDB-UFES, when available.

columns.name: sab_wsi_label
columns.description: Retained field name for the source-level label carried by SAB, when available.

columns.name: public_ndb_origin_ids
columns.description: Public NDB origin identifiers supporting the source-image match.

columns.name: public_ndb_wsi_matches
columns.description: Retained field name for the number of public NDB-UFES source-image matches recorded for the group.

columns.name: patches_oscc
columns.description: Atlas patches carrying the complete OSCC label.

columns.name: patches_with_dysplasia
columns.description: Atlas patches carrying the complete dysplasia label.

columns.name: patches_without_dysplasia
columns.description: Atlas patches carrying the complete without-dysplasia label.

columns.name: patch_labels_unavailable
columns.description: Atlas patches without an available complete patch label.

columns.name: evidence_summary
columns.description: JSON object encoded as CSV text with atlas linkage-evidence counts.

columns.name: manual_review_count
columns.description: Atlas rows requiring manual review in the validated-linkage output.

columns.name: metadata_conflict_patch_count
columns.description: Atlas patches flagged with metadata conflict; this is not a final label decision.
